name: document-page
title: Document Page - A Document Read In Full, With Its Regions
description: A whole document screen: the document read in full as a record, its body held to the reading measure, and one or more regions beside it drawn by the settled Blocks. A version list, a comment thread, a source list, an output list and an evidence comparison matrix are regions of this one Page rather than six Items. Every word, column, member and arm is passed in as a prop.
